fields.Name: C1 -> S6.1
fields.Description: Gate G2.6 (phase 2, dataset C1, criterion S6.1): the C1 holdout is carved by decision date after the declared cutoff; 100% of stored holdout keys fall after it, 0 are in training, and at the reference's cutoff they equal its 1,205 test keys. The protocol declares 2024-01-01 to 2025-01-01; the keys are the snapshot manifest's locked-holdout rows, compared with fixtures/c1-corpus/c1_reference_test_keys.csv. It fails when DateCarvedCarver carves the trailing fraction in read order (holdout keys before the cutoff > 0).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 1,205 stored holdout keys, all on or after 2024-01-01, none in training, equal to the reference's 1,205 test keys.
